story-01-reptiloids.purpose: Contextual reading for narrowly supported shared rules
story-01-reptiloids.reason: Parent editorial candidates were known before this contextual reading; source was not read and this is not the final revision.

authority_boundary: The additions are process invariants and contextual editorial criteria. No new dictionary/orthographic prohibition and no author-approved individual style rule is asserted. Existing reference links are preserved, not re-certified.

rules.finding: Legacy source_units counts empty lines. The baseline TXT totals 115/471/619 correspond to 58/236/310 nonempty units, totaling 604 target units. Source IDs have a separate denominator.
rules.change: Keep p/start and source_units stable; add explicit blank/nonempty counts and source_unit_kind to both scanners.
rules.scope: All supported text and DOCX scans; this is extraction accounting, not reading.
rules.negative_control: Hard-wrapped TXT lines are not renamed as literary paragraphs. Blank DOCX paragraphs and excluded parts remain visible.

rules.evidence: INITIAL-DIAGNOSIS.json and parent report of prior 21/600 source-ID rereading
rules.finding: Zero configured signals and a matching hash cannot establish native prose or completed reading. The historical 21/600 reading figure is parent-supplied, not revalidated by this task.
rules.change: Expose reading_coverage as not_assessed_by_this_tool with null reviewed count; require factual reader ranges in the separate language report and identify source versus target numbering.
rules.scope: Full language review claims; do not turn a generated list of all IDs into reading evidence.
rules.negative_control: Resolving every signal, including a resolutions file claiming complete reading, does not promote scanner reading coverage or literary quality.

evidence.quote: глянувши на нього своїми золотавими тонкими зіницями
evidence.context: Чоловіки перезирнулися. Першим зняв маску Андрій, глянувши на нього своїми золотавими тонкими зіницями.

rules.origin: Parent supplied a working candidate; quote and local context independently checked against the specified target file.
rules.finding: The instrument of looking draws attention to an unintended physical mechanism; the pupil description may still serve the reveal.
rules.change: Add a narrow contextual detector pupils_as_gaze_instrument and a reading criterion for actor/action/instrument/image. Do not apply a replacement.
rules.scope: Only a gaze-verb construction followed by своїми and up to three modifiers before зіницями, within one sentence span.
negative_control: Глянув на кота з вузькими зіницями.
Уже дві пари вертикальних зіниць дивилися на веселуна.

evidence.context: Кухнею прокотився гучний, заразливий сміх, сповнюючи простір гумором і щирістю. Ясна річ, ніякої ящірки там не було. Лише усміхнене обличчя Дімона після посередньої пантоміми.

rules.origin: Parent working candidate, followed by target-context reading.
rules.finding: The abstract explanation follows already audible laughter; a contextual edit can remove the extra explanation while keeping the emotional reaction.
rules.change: Add a reading criterion for emotion restated after a shown response, preserving the actual action. No general regex for abstract nouns.
rules.scope: Narrator explanation that duplicates an already presented response in this scene.

evidence.context: Усі погляди зосередилися на сталеварі. Він підвівся й удав, ніби повільно знімає маску. «Уууууаааа», — простогнав він, і мужики голосно розреготалися.

rules.origin: Parent proposed a more active local alternative.
rules.finding: A local preference for an active verb does not establish that the original construction is an error in every scene.
rules.change: Keep this outside automated forbidden formulas; assess the sentence in its scene.

evidence.context: — Дімоне, якби я не знав тебе стільки років, то подумав би, що ти схибнувся, і відвіз би тебе до лікарні. Не знаю, як там щодо рептилоїдів, але тут явно коїться якась дичина. Ти як, заспокоївся? Ходімо перевіримо, — запропонував Олег.

rules.origin: Parent working candidate; corrected anchor is target unit 45 / physical line 89, not target unit 44.
rules.finding: The slang meaning belongs to the speaker and exchange; changing it needs a contextual register decision.
rules.change: Clarify conversational-meaning review and keep дичина out of global lexical bans or automatic replacements.
rules.scope: Colloquial function, surrounding reply and voice; not a normative assertion about the word.
